results.title: Hayden Panettiere's mother calls out 'toxic individual' in death case
results.description: Hayden Panettiere's mother spoke about their estrangement and a toxic individual. She believes this person contributed to her daughter's untimely death at thirty-six. The mother mentioned family efforts to remove this individual from Panettiere's life. Panettiere's boyfriend's attorney stated police found no signs of foul play. An investigation into the actress's death is currently ongoing.
